page_title: NEW 2-1 MCI | Newcastle v Manchester City 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
90+7' Nico (Manchester City) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
90+6' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) is about to take a corner kick.
90+4' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90+2' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' The resulting corner from Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) is cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City).
89' Savinho (Manchester City) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Manchester City will have an opportunity.
87' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Phil Foden and he is replaced by Omar Marmoush (Manchester City).
86' Phil Foden (Manchester City) will take the corner.
85' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Nick Woltemade will be replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Elanga (Newcastle Utd) replaces Harvey Barnes.
82' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
80' Nico (Manchester City) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle.
77' Eddie Howe is forced to make a change. Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Sven Botman.
77' Rayan Cherki will be replaced by Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) for Bernardo Silva.
76' Here is a change. Jeremy Doku is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Savinho (Manchester City).
74' Referee Samuel Barrott points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) goes wild in celebration.
72' Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott has indicated he is going to review the Newcastle goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
70' Gianluigi Donnarumma (Manchester City) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
70' 2 - 1 Goal! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 2:1.
70' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) only hits the crossbar with a bullet header!
70' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) whips in a dangerous corner straight at goal, but it is cleared off the line by a defender.
70' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) will take a corner kick.
70' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
68' 1 - 1 What a hit! Ruben Dias (Manchester City) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the middle of the net. 1:1.
68' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

67' Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
66' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
63' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Bruno Guimaraes provided an assist for the goal.
63' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
60' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

59' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Nick Pope, who pulls off a comfortable save!

58' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Gianluigi Donnarumma anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
55' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) sends a chip pass into the box, but Nick Pope is quickest to intercept the ball.
53' Flag up against Jeremy Doku (Manchester City). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
52' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.

49' Close! Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
49' The ball is cleared after Erling Haaland (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

46' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Newcastle will have a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Phil Foden (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box from a free kick, but his attempt is well judged by the keeper who saves comfortably.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

42' Rayan Cherki plays a lovely pass into Phil Foden (Manchester City), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
40' Samuel Barrott blows for a foul after Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
38' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
38' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Newcastle win a corner kick.

35' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Nick Pope anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
34' Phil Foden (Manchester City) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
33' Phil Foden (Manchester City) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
33' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

31' Golden chance! Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
29' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

26' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
24' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) was too forceful with his tackle and Samuel Barrott interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
20' 33:67 – the ratio of ball possession.
19' Referee Samuel Barrott signals NO PENALTY for Manchester City after a VAR review!

18' There's a break in play and referee Samuel Barrott must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Manchester City using VAR. This could be interesting!
18' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
18' Phil Foden (Manchester City) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

17' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Erling Haaland (Manchester City) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
16' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' Nico (Manchester City) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Samuel Barrott stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
14' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
13' Nick Woltemade (Newcastle Utd) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
12' Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
10' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Nick Pope.
8' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
7' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

6' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
4' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Manchester City will kick the game off.
Samuel Barrott will supervise the game today.
